rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that is acceptable or okay, whether suitable or merely passable.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 ho2 ji5 wo3

rows.note: Use this when acceptable means suitable, appropriate, or right for a person or purpose.

example.english: Is this time acceptable to you?
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 si4 gaan3 ngaam1 nei5 maa3

rows.note: Use this when something is only passable or good enough but not impressive.

example.english: This report is acceptable, but not outstanding.
example.traditional: 呢份報告過得去，但唔算出色。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 gwo3 dak1 heoi3 daan6 m4 syun3 ceot1 sik1
